The model treats the −1 as a mild dampener on an otherwise flat day, not as the leading edge of a sector reversal.
CORRECTED_BEHAVIOR: When a sector has run 1w rel >+4% and 1m rel >+10%, and the current morning shows (a) the sector's own commodity offered (WTI −1.19%), (b) 1d rel already stalled at +0.07% (near zero after a big run), and (c) premarket breadth soft (XOM/CVX/COP red), the model should recognize this as an exhaustion/reversal setup and score S1=−2 (oil offered + extended-run mean reversion) rather than capping at −1 via the 08-12 continuation rule. DO-INSTEAD should not override a genuine oil-offered + extended-run reversal signal into flat; it should only cap magnitude when the direction itself is ambiguous. When S1=−2 and S4=0 with a broad market ripping on macro (ISM beat), the correct call is down/mild-to-notable, not flat/flat.
